164193.overview:
Envahi is a side view fixed screen shoot 'em up where the player controls a helicopter and must defend a city that is being attacked by an invasion force. Next to the city is a large dam full of water that also has to be defended. The helicopter can be moved in all directions and shoots bullets upwards.

There are four different types of enemies to shoot down. Munchers move horizontally towards the dam and make holes in it upon reaching it. If the hole goes all the way through, the water will flood the city. Nasties appear from a mothership at the top and move downwards until reaching a building. Slideys do the same but move faster and from side to side. Bully bailiffs attempt to capture the helicopter and leave with it. Additionally, the player has to watch out for rain drops since the helicopter is water-soluble. A life is lost every time a building is captured, the helicopter crashes or the dam floods. Three lives are available at the start.

164982.overview: In this game you play the role of a man who has been deatomized by a rogue 6502 processor and are now trapped inside the computer. The gameplay involves you running around a maze collecting both the key which opens up the exit for the level and also the program disk. The MCP is following you all the time and if it makes contact with you you lose a life. There are also walls and blocks which switch from visible to invisible making it harder to run as you can't walk through them.

165711.overview:
The Exterminator is essentially a clone of the arcade game Centipede. A centipede forms from the top of the screen and gradually moves down it, changing direction when striking the many barriers it hits. If it reaches the bottom of the screen, it wins. You control a small droid, which can move up the screen shooting out the centipede, cutting it shorter each time). You can also shoot the barriers, which take multiple hits to remove - the less barriers there are, the longer it will take for the centipede to reach the bottom.

Occasionally a phoenix will appear, either moving horizontally towards the bottom of the screen, or vertically down from the top, to shoot for a points bonus or avoid. You have three lives, but on losing one you gain points for any remaining pieces of centipede. The high score is updated constantly once you pass it, and (unusually for the time) an attract mode demos the game.

168556.overview: One minute you were out in a shopping centre, the next a huge Earthquake rips through the centre causing devastation around you, but at least you survived. Your aim now is to get out of the shopping centre but first you have to help the other survivors as well. Earthquake is a text adventure aimed at kids where text describes each location you visit and you type in commands with the keyboard to interact with your surroundings.

185280.overview:
Junior Maths: Engineshed is an educational game for the VIC-20.

The player answers math questions to help drive a train engine into a shed. After 15 questions the engine arrives. The player can choose addition, subtraction, multiplication, or division.

418713.overview:
Electra Sport Soccer is a 1-player arcade game for the VIC-20

The player controls a single soccer player that tries to push a soccer ball into a single net. The player moves in the cardinal directions, and the distance the soccer ball travels depends upon how fast the player pushes the ball. If the ball is pushed into a wall and bounces back to the player, the level is restarted. The player tries to score in the fewest possible kicks. There is only one level, and 4 levels of difficulty.

Despite the game's name, this is more of a general action game than an actual sports game.

419340.overview:
Emmet Attack is a 1-player arcade game for the VIC-20.

The player controls the turret of an attack vessel that must defeat the incoming Emmet force. The screen scrolls laterally if the turret is moved off the edge of the screen. Spider-like Emmets move laterally across the screen starting at the horizon until they reach a mountain and hide. They then later appear slightly closer to the bottom of the screen, and repeat this pattern. The player must destroy 10 Emmets before they reach the bottom of the screen, and then advance to a level with faster moving creatures.

419349.overview:
It is 2020. It has been 2020 forever. It will be 2020 forever more. You must escape 2020.

Collect all 44 keys from the rooms of 2020 and find the exit to escape. Your task won't be easy. There are monsters roaming the many rooms and they aren't looking to be your friend. Blast them before you become their dinner. Oh, did I say they have acid for blood? Well of course they do, this is 2020 afterall.

Use the joystick to run around and shoot. Watch out when entering a room - you'll only get a second to avoid any monsters that are close by.

423437.overview:
English Invaders is an educational arcade game for the VIC-20.

The player controls a small cannon at the bottom of the screen that moves laterally, and fires vertically. Letters move down from the top of the screen, and the player must shoot them while correctly identifying them as a verb, noun, or adjective.

460592.overview:
E.T.: The Extra-Terrestrial is an unofficial game developed for the Commodore VIC-20 around 1983 by H. Jans. 
Inspired by the famous movie, the game offers arcade-style gameplay: E.T. runs across a scrolling landscape, 
avoiding lasers and obstacles while collecting Reese’s Pieces to score points.
